lightIdle: Chwetheza naliphi na idilesi yesayithi. Sihlola uluhlu lwethu lwezoyikiso, isakhiwo, ukulinganisa iimpawu, i-DNS nempendulo ephilayo. Ku-Yima: phuma, qinisekisa ngejelo elisemthethweni elisele ulithembile, uze uxele ukuba uyafuna.
lightLimited: Kucacile kuthetha ukuba uhlolo olwenziweyo aluzange lunike isilumkiso esinamandla — ayisosithembiso sokuba isayithi ikhuselekile.
privacyNote: Okuhlala kukho: akugcinwa nto. Uhlolo lwempazamo lunceda ukulungisa iingxaki zobugcisa kuphela — soze ibe yidilesi, kwaye soze ibe kukukhupha esidlangalaleni.
privacyPolicyIntro: I-buusdo Cybersecurity Service Tool (umgca weemveliso we-Buusdo — imveliso eyahlukileyo) ikunceda ukhangela idilesi yesayithi phambi kokuba uyithembe. Uhlolo lusebenzisa imiqondiso zethu ngqo noluhlu lwethu lwezoyikiso olulondolozwayo. Eli phepha sisaziso semfihlo semveliso yewebhusayithi, i-extension yebhrawuza, kunye ne-app yedeskithophu.
privacyPolicyWhatBody: Xa uqhuba uhlolo, idilesi oyifakayo isetyenzwa kwiseva ye-buusdo ukuze kuhlalutywe isakhiwo, kufaniswe noluhlu lwethu lwezoyikiso, kwaye ngokuzikhethela kuvavanywe ukufikeleleka okuphilayo (i-DNS / i-HTTP). Asithumeli ii-URL ezikhangelweyo ku-Google Safe Browsing okanye kwezinye ii-API zodumo zesithathu, kwaye asithengisi idatha yohlolo.
privacyPolicyStoreBody: Okuhlala kukho: akugcinwa nto. Ungakhetha ugcino lwesi sixhobo kuphela (uluhlu lokuthintela/lokuthemba, imbali yohlolo ngokuzikhethela) kwibhrawuza, kwi-extension, okanye kwi-app yedeskithophu. Uhlolo lwempazamo loncedo luquka umthombo nohlobo lwesoyikiso kuphela — soze ibe yidilesi epheleleyo, kwaye soze ibe kukukhupha esidlangalaleni okanye intengiso.
privacyPolicyAccountBody: I-buusdo ayiniki iakhawunti yefu okanye ungqamaniso loluhlu phakathi kwezixhobo. Uluhlu lwakho lokuthintela/lokuthemba luhlala kwesi sixhobo. Luhambise ngokukhuphela/ukungenisa i-JSON okanye i-QR ye-shield-lists-v1, okanye ungqamanise ngokwakho ifayile ye-shield-backup.json yedeskithophu (i-USB, i-Drive, i-Syncthing).
privacyPolicyContactBody: Kwimibuzo yemfihlo okanye yemveliso, qhagamshelana nomsebenzi wokumiselwa kwakho kwe-buusdo nge-imeyile yakhe esemthethweni okanye ijelo loncedo (umntu okanye umbutho oqhuba i-Cloudflare Worker). Khetha loo dilesi esemthethweni oyaziyo — hayi ifowuni okanye i-imeyile eprintiweyo kwisayithi oyikhangelayo. Ungancamathiseli iziphumo zohlolo ezinobuzaza kumajelo esidlangalala.
privacyPolicyLimitsBody: Akukho kutyhilwa kwe-TLS — i-HTTPS CONNECT yigama lomamkeli kuphela; akukho satifikethi se-MITM. Akukho kubulawa kweenkqubo — iinkqubo ezisebenzayo ziyaqhubeka. Iifolda zenkqubo ziyingxelo kuphela — /usr, /etc, iindlela zenkqubo ze-Windows, kunye ne-Program Files azisoze zishenxiswa okanye zihlelwe. Akukho njanji ye-AV okanye yeemiyidala, kwaye akukho kubanjwa kwamagama okugqithisa okanye imbali yokubhrawuza.
desktopDownloadsIntro: Faka i-buusdo kule khompyutha ukusuka ku-GitHub Release (iqokobhe lebhrawuza + itreyi). Izakhiwo azisayinwanga — jonga isikhokelo sokufaka. Ukuvula xa ungena kuhlala kucinyiwe de ukuvule.
desktopDownloadUnsignedUntilPromote: Isakhiwo esingasayinwanga (asinali-notarized). I-macOS inokuthintela ukuvula kokuqala — landela isikhokelo sokufaka (i-xattr / Privacy & Security). I-Windows SmartScreen inokulumkisa ngoMshicileli ongaziwayo.
desktopDownloadReadyToPromote: Inqaku elidala: ukukhuphela okunali-notarized akusetyenziswa kule ndlela — gcina i-zip ye-GitHub engasayinwanga njengeyokuqala.
privacyDesktopMirrorNote: Ukhuphelo lwe-macOS yedeskithophu: isibuko se-CDN siyasebenza; i-GitHub Release ihlala iyindlela ebhaliweyo yokubuyela.
privacy: Olu hlolo luhlala kule khompyutha. Akugcinwa mbali yokubhrawuza.
invalid: Faka idilesi ye-HTTP okanye i-HTTPS esemthethweni.
ignoreRiskBody: Unokunikezela amagama okugqithisa, iinkcukacha zentlawulo, okanye enye idatha yobuqu kulowo ulawula le dilesi. Vala ithebhu phambi kokuchwetheza okanye ukuhlawula nantoni na.
nextStepLeave: Phuma kweli phepha ngoku — ungakuqhubeki kwidilesi oyikhangelileyo.
nextStepNoCredentials: Ungafaki amagama okugqithisa, iinombolo zamakhadi, iikhowudi ze-SMS/imeyile, okanye enye idatha yobuqu kule sayithi.
nextStepVerifyOfficial: Qinisekisa ngokuzimeleyo: vula idomeyini okanye i-app esemthethweni yombutho osele uwuthembile (ibhukhimakhi, ikhadi lebhanki, ivenkile ye-app eyaziwayo). Ungasebenzisi iifowuni okanye ii-imeyile ezikwiphepha elikrokrisayo.
nextStepReport: Ukhetho: gcina ngezantsi uyilo lwengxelo yalapha ukuze umsebenzi ahlaziye umamkeli woluhlu lwezoyikiso olulondolozwayo.
nextStepBlock: Ukhetho: thintela umamkeli kwi-extension okanye i-app yedeskithophu ye-buusdo ukuze kube nzima ukuyivula ngempazamo.
nextStepLooksReal: Amaphepha obuqhophololo ahlala ebonakala ecocekile kwaye asebenzise i-HTTPS. Ubunjani bokubonakala abungqini ukuba isayithi isemthethweni.
honestLimitNoWipe: I-buusdo ayinakucima ulwazi lobuqu isayithi sele iluqokelele. Tshintsha amagama okugqithisa kwisayithi yokwenene esemthethweni ukuba ufake nantoni na, kwaye ubukele izilumkiso zebhanki/imeyile.
honestLimitNoCrowd: Iziphumo zivela kuluhlu olulondolozwayo nemiqondiso yedilesi ye-buusdo — hayi inani loluntu leevoti zokuba bangaphi abantu abaye baxela isayithi.
honestLimitNoAv: Oku asiyiyo imveliso yokulwa iintsholongwane. Ukuvala ithebhu kumisa ukufaka idatha apha; ayiskeni okanye icocise isixhobo sakho.
actionSensitiveNote: Ungafaki ulwazi olubuthathaka ngaphandle kokuba unokuqinisekisa idilesi ngomthombo ozimeleyo.
feedbackReportExportHint: Uyilo lugciniwe. Vula iiSetingi → Uyilo lwengxelo ukuze ukhuphele ifayile ye-batches/*.json ukuze umsebenzi ahlaziye — akukho nto ithunyelwayo.
faqNoWipeTitle: Ingaba i-buusdo inokucima idatha isayithi esele iyithathile?
faqNoWipeBody: Hayi. Tshintsha amagama okugqithisa kwisayithi yokwenene esemthethweni ukuba kufakwe nantoni na, kwaye ubukele izilumkiso zebhanki okanye ze-imeyile.
faqNoAvBody: Hayi. Ukuvala ithebhu kumisa ukufaka idatha ngakumbi kuleyo dilesi; ayiskeni okanye icocise isixhobo.
faqNoCrowdTitle: Ingaba inqaku livela kwiivoti zabanye abasebenzisi?
faqNoCrowdBody: Hayi. Iziphumo zisebenzisa uluhlu lwezoyikiso olulondolozwayo lwe-buusdo nemiqondiso yedilesi — hayi inani lesidlangalala lokuba bangaphi abantu abaye baxela oku.
protection: Sebenzisa i-extension okanye i-app yedeskithophu ukuhlaziya uluhlu lokukhusela.
currentlyBlocked: ithintelwe kwi-extension okanye i-app yedeskithophu xa uyongeza apho.
resetDone: Imbali yasekhaya, uyilo, kunye nezitshixo zoluhlu ezidala zicinyiwe.
blockListsWebsiteNote: Le webhusayithi ayilunyanzelisi uluhlu lokuthintela/lokuthemba (i-extension nedeskithophu ziyenza oko). Uluhlu luhlala esixhobeni.
blockListsOfflinePath: Indlela phakathi kwezixhobo: khuphela/ngenisa i-JSON okanye i-QR ye-shield-lists-v1 kwi-extension okanye i-app yedeskithophu. Ideskithophu inokungqamanisa i-shield-backup.json nge-USB, i-Drive, okanye i-Syncthing — akukho akhawunti yefu.
listsOfflineIntro: Uluhlu lokuthintela nolokuthemba luhlala kwisixhobo ngasinye. Akukho akhawunti yefu ye-buusdo. Sebenzisa ukhuphelo/ungeniso okanye ungqamaniso lwefayile.
listsOfflineStepExport: Kwi-extension okanye i-app yedeskithophu, khuphela i-shield-lists-v1 (i-JSON okanye i-QR).
listsOfflineStepMove: Kopa ifayile okanye skena i-QR kwesinye isixhobo (i-USB, i-Drive, umyalezo owuzithumelela wona).
listsOfflineStepImport: Ngenisa kwesinye isixhobo. Kungcono umbhali omnye ngexesha.
listsOfflineDesktopBody: I-app yedeskithophu igcina uluhlu njenge-shield-backup.json kwifolda yedatha yayo. Ungangqamanisa loo folda nge-Syncthing, i-Drive, okanye i-USB. Ukuba izixhobo ezimbini zibhala ngaxeshanye, khuphela kwakhona kwisixhobo osithembayo uze ungenise kwesinye.
accountHint: Ngokuzikhethela. Ngqamanisa uluhlu lobuqu lokuthintela/lokuthemba kuphela phakathi kwewebhusayithi, i-extension, nedeskithophu. Soze kungqanyaniswe imbali yohlolo okanye ii-URL ezipheleleyo.
accountDisabled: Ungqamaniso lweakhawunti lucinyiwe kule seva (ACCOUNT_SYNC_ENABLED). Sebenzisa ugcino lwangaphandle kwe-intanethi ngezantsi, okanye cela umsebenzi ukuba aluvule ungqamaniso.
accountMagicSent: Ukuba loo dilesi inokufumana i-imeyile, ikhonkco lokungena lithunyelwe (uphuhliso lunokubonisa ikhonkco ngezantsi).
accountSyncToggleHint: Xa ivuliwe, uNgqamanisa ngoku utyhala kwaye utsala i-shield-lists-v1. Ukuphuma akusicimi uluhlu lwefu.
accountStagingPlaceholder: Ncamathelisa i-JSON ye-shield-lists-v1 ukutyhala, okanye Ngqamanisa ngoku ukutsala.
accountDeleteConfirm: Cima le akhawunti kunye nomboniso woluhlu lwefu? Oku akunakubuyiselwa. Uluhlu lwasekhaya kwi-extension/ideskithophu aluchaphazeleki.
accountSignOutNote: Ukuphuma akusicimi uluhlu lwefu. Ukucima iakhawunti kuyenza oko.
accountOfflineBackup: Ugcino lwangaphandle kwe-intanethi: khuphela/ngenisa i-JSON okanye i-QR ye-shield-lists-v1 ukusuka kwi-extension okanye i-app yedeskithophu.
accountSyncNeedPrivacy: Khetha Esi sixhobo kuphela okanye Uhlolo lwempazamo loncedo phambi kokungqamanisa uluhlu olulungelelaniswayo kule sayithi.
accountSyncEmpty: Akukho luhlu lwefu okwangoku — ncamathelisa i-JSON uze ucofe uNgqamanisa ngoku ukulayisha.
accountListsTooMany: Kukho amanqaku amaninzi kakhulu okuthintela/okuthemba kungqamaniso lwefu.
accountListsTooLarge: I-JSON yoluhlu idlula umda wobukhulu befu.
blockListsPrivacySurfaces: Ku-Ungagcine soze: i-extension icima uluhlu lobuqu kwi-chrome.storage; i-app yedeskithophu ibuza phambi kokucima i-shield-backup.json kwidiski.
blockListsLiveDeepLink: Ukuthintela nokuthemba kusebenza kwi-extension / ideskithophu — vula amaxwebhu okufaka
leaveAndBlockSettingsCta: Vula iiSetingi — uluhlu lokuthintela lusebenza kwi-extension / ideskithophu
ambiguousProbeNotPhishing: Ukuthintelwa kwe-bot okanye ukuthotywa kuvavanyo akubobungqina bobuqhophololo — vula isayithi kwibhrawuza eqhelekileyo ukuba usayifuna.
probeBlocked403Detail: Kufunyenwe i-HTTP 403 (Forbidden). Isayithi yala olu hlolo oluzenzekelayo — oko akubobungqina bobuqhophololo. Zama idilesi kwibhrawuza eqhelekileyo ukuba kuyimfuneko.
probeBlocked429Detail: Kufunyenwe i-HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests). Isayithi ithothise olu hlolo — oko akubobungqina bobuqhophololo. Linda uze uzame kwakhona, okanye vula idilesi kwibhrawuza eqhelekileyo.
probeBlocked503Detail: Kufunyenwe i-HTTP 503 (Service Unavailable). Isayithi okanye umda unokuxinwa — oko akubobungqina bobuqhophololo. Zama kwakhona kamva kwibhrawuza eqhelekileyo ukuba kuyimfuneko.
personalListLeaveNote: Ukuphuma kucetyiswe luluhlu lwakho lobuqu lokuthintela (i-extension / ideskithophu). Le webhusayithi ayilugcinanga uluhlu.

historyNote: Idomeyini, inqanaba lengozi, i-ms yovavanyo nokuphelelwa lixesha kuphela — soze ibe yidilesi epheleleyo. Iyacima xa iDatha ikwi-Ungagcine soze.

I-CSV yesishwankathelo sokuphelelwa lixesha ibandakanya ikholamu ye-probeBlocked (inani lohlolo oluthintelweyo lwe-403/429/503 ngomamkeli — soze ibe yi-URL epheleleyo).
